comments.mergedPostDetails:
Since one of the recent updates, the wrist on one of my avatars is rotated in a strange way in-game. I did a git-bisect on my avatar project to narrow it down to one of the dynamic bone components.

I have the following setup (simplified):

```
Miko
  Armature
    Hips
      Spine
        Chest
          Left Shoulder
            Left Arm
              Left Elbow
                Left Wrist
              Left Sleeve
```

In order to add physics simulation to "Left Sleeve", I have a dynamic bone component on "Miko" with its root set to "Left Arm". I have then added "Left Elbow" as an exclusion to that dynamic bone component to prevent things other than "Left Sleeve" from being affected.

This causes the wrist to be rotated inward by about 45° in-game. If I disable the dynamic bone component, the wrist is no longer rotated. This happens with VRChat 2021.2.2p1 [1097] and VRCSDK2-2021.05.21.12.13. It worked fine until one of the recent updates (it first happened about one week ago, but I do not play every day). It does not seem to happen in desktop mode. It also does not happen within Unity when I "Play" the scene with the avatar in it.

Let me know if I can do anything else to help.
comments.mergedPostTitle: [1097] Wrist Rotation Broken Since Recent Update
